label: Guayaquil → Algeciras: 13-Ton Banana Box Cocaine Seizure
notes: Spanish authorities seize over 13 tonnes of cocaine hidden in banana boxes shipped from Guayaquil — the largest single-container cocaine haul in Spanish counter-narcotics history.

label: Posorja → Rotterdam: Leading European Cocaine Corridor
notes: Rotterdam port authorities report seizing more than six tons of cocaine originating from Ecuador's Posorja port in 2024 alone — nearly double the next-largest source port.

label: Guayaquil → Antwerp/Northern Europe: Dismantled Trafficking Network
notes: Europol-Ecuador joint operation dismantles a network moving cocaine from Ecuadorian ports to Belgium, Germany, and the Netherlands; 73 tons seized cumulatively, 50 suspects arrested.

label: San Lorenzo ↔ Tumaco: Colombia Border Trafficking Corridor
notes: Key overland and riverine route linking Ecuadorian trafficking networks with Colombian ex-FARC dissident groups operating around Tumaco.

label: Fito Extradition Flight — Guayaquil to Brooklyn
notes: Adolfo 'Fito' Macías is flown from Guayaquil to the United States to face federal drug trafficking and gun smuggling charges in Brooklyn.

label: US Air Force Deployment to Manta's Eloy Alfaro Base
notes: US Air Force personnel deploy temporarily to Manta for joint intelligence and interdiction training — the first acknowledged US military return to the former Manta FOL site since 2009.

label: B-52 Bomber Bilateral Exercise — First Entry into Ecuadorian Airspace
notes: A US B-52 strategic bomber enters Ecuadorian airspace for the first time as part of a bilateral defense cooperation exercise, signaling the depth of the renewed US-Ecuador military relationship.

label: DHS Secretary Noem's Visit to Quito
notes: DHS Secretary Kristi Noem travels to Quito to meet President Noboa and expand bilateral migration and counter-narcotics cooperation.

label: Joint US-Ecuador Operations Corridor — March 2026
notes: Coordinated Ecuadorian-US operations against Los Choneros and Los Lobos extend along the northern coastal corridor between Manta and Esmeraldas.

label: Guayaquil → Quito Internal Displacement Flow
notes: One of the principal internal displacement routes as residents flee gang-controlled Guayaquil neighborhoods for the relatively safer capital.

label: Esmeraldas → Ibarra Displacement Flow
notes: Families flee Esmeraldas province's port-trafficking violence for the northern highlands city of Ibarra.

label: Machala → Cuenca Displacement Flow
notes: Displacement route from El Oro's prison-violence-affected Machala to the historically safer southern highlands city of Cuenca.

label: Tulcán → Ipiales Cross-Border Displacement
notes: Some Ecuadorians fleeing gang violence cross into Colombia via the Tulcán-Ipiales border crossing, part of an outflow that has seen over 400,000 people leave Ecuador.

label: Guayas-Esmeraldas Violence Corridor
notes: The coastal corridor between Guayaquil and Esmeraldas records the highest concentration of homicides nationally, driven by competition for port access and trafficking routes.

label: Los Lobos European Network — Leader Arrested in Spain
notes: Spanish authorities arrest a man identified as an alleged Los Lobos leader, illustrating the gang's cocaine distribution reach into Europe.

label: Manta → Mexico: OFAC-Sanctioned Fishing Fleet Cocaine Network
notes: US Treasury/OFAC sanctioned 15 individuals and entities plus 10 fishing vessels based in Manta, alleging the network used ostensibly legitimate fishing operations to refuel and resupply 'go-fast' boats moving thousands of kilograms of cocaine monthly toward Mexico for onward distribution to the US by the Sinaloa Cartel and CJNG. Network affiliated with FTOs Los Choneros and Los Lobos.

label: Posorja → Lázaro Cárdenas: 1.01-Ton Cocaine Seizure Hidden in Machinery
notes: Ecuadorian police seized 1.01 tonnes of cocaine hidden inside four pieces of machinery in a container declared as an 'electromagnetic lifting system,' bound for Mexico's Lázaro Cárdenas port; the container had been flagged as high-risk by CIAPA on August 13 before its August 20 inspection.
